claims: The shipped 350Z PCK contains a rest-joint named trunkbone at index16 with native global XYZ (0,1.240475,0.767380), so adding this source translation to its local trunk geometry is evidence-supported for the static preview.
The generic ELF skeleton loader stores local XYZ at joint+0x20 and sums ancestor local translations to write global XYZ at joint+0, with joint stride0x44.

All94 recovered main PCKs expose a bone array at modelroot+0x68 via skeletonheader+8, whose first ushort is the array count; the executable corpus probe finds no globalXYZ/localXYZ ancestry mismatches above1e-5.
